subject.title: fix(mcp): standalone apps stop hanging on stalled gateway requests

question: Should a session MCP runtime continue a current catalog refresh after its final operation waiter detaches, so it may warm the shared cache until request completion, invalidation, or runtime disposal?
rationale: This determines the product-level balance between avoiding duplicate reconnect/list work and bounding background MCP-server work after callers have already timed out; tests can verify either choice but cannot select the intended lifecycle contract.

options.title: Approve runtime-owned cache warming
options.body: Keep the proposed detachment semantics and document that catalog work remains runtime-owned until completion, invalidation, or disposal.

options.title: Abort when no operation waiters remain
options.body: Restore last-waiter cancellation to minimize orphaned server work, accepting more reconnects and repeated catalog discovery.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Land only the standalone operation-deadline fixes and defer shared catalog-refresh ownership to a separately owned design change.

recommendation.title: Approve runtime-owned cache warming
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed detachment semantics and document that catalog work remains runtime-owned until completion, invalidation, or disposal.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only identified reviewer with direct evidence on the timeout contract, but their supplied comment appropriately signals that a broader MCP runtime owner should make the lifecycle decision.
